label: Party
tagline: For a birthday or a kids' party, for young and old.
name: The Party Game

invitation.headline: Will you come to my party?

chance.text: The party starts! Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
Everyone is ready at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
You get to bring the first present to {11}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The power goes out. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
You are late for the party. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You pop out for more ice cream. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You guess exactly how many sweets are in the jar.
You make a wish over the candles. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You forgot the present. Go back three spaces.
You give away the surprise. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The whole house needs decorating. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You buy candles at the last minute.
You get a ride in {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
You treat the whole table. Pay each player {currency}40.
You win the quiz about the birthday person.
The birthday person wants a photo with you at {39}. Go there.

chest.text: Everyone sings for the birthday person. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
You win the top prize at bingo.
You drop the cake and fetch a new one.
You find money in a party bag.
The birthday person sticks up for you. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You sneak the last slice of cake. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You find money under the present table.
It is your birthday too! Each player gives you {currency}10.
You win the prize for the silliest hat.
You hire a bouncy castle at the last minute.
You grab a present on the way there.
You get the deposit back on all the empty bottles.
After the party everything needs cleaning. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
You find a coin in your slice of cake.
You sell the photos from the photo corner.

houseRules: The birthday person may change one rule once per game.
Whoever throws a double says something kind about the birthday person.
Whoever lands on {0} starts a song and everyone sings along.
